characters.continuity: StarCraft II: Heart of the Swarm
characters.summary: Sarah Kerrigan is the Queen of Blades, possessing terrifying psionic power combined with terrifying biological prowess. She fights using devastating psionic blasts, mental domination, and a horde of controllable zerg organisms.
weaknesses: Xel'naga artifacts or specialized dampening tech designed to suppress psionic energy
limitations: Psionic power requires intense concentration and can be disrupted by specialized tech

sources.supports: Abilities, psionic powers, and campaign history of Sarah Kerrigan.

feats.claim: Destroyed military installations and armies using raw psionic energy and zerg swarms.
feats.citation: StarCraft II: Heart of the Swarm campaign

notableResults.note: Defeated and manipulated across multiple conflicts.

campaignTags.claim: Kerrigan flies naturally using her zerg wings.
Extremely potent psionic manipulation and telekinesis.
Rapid biological healing through zerg cellular regeneration.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of her ascended Xel'naga form versus her original Queen of Blades form.

characters.summary: Scorpion is a resurrected specter fueled by vengeance, wielding hellfire and his signature spear. He closes distance effortlessly with his spear pull before executing opponents with brutal martial arts and supernatural flame.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to holy magic, purification, and attacks that disrupt Netherrealm ties
limitations: Power can fluctuate depending on proximity to the Netherrealm

sources.supports: Scorpion's history, techniques, and hellfire abilities.

feats.claim: Dragged Sub-Zero into the Netherrealm to burn him alive.

notableResults.note: Avenged his clan by defeating Bi-Han.

campaignTags.claim: Generates and controls hellfire.
Can teleport instantly to and from the Netherrealm or across the battlefield.

unknowns: Exact extent of his power when separated entirely from Netherrealm magic.

characters.summary: Sephiroth is a legendary SOLDIER wielding the massive Odachin blade, Masamune. He combines master swordsmanship with supreme magical mastery and immense gravitational manipulation.
weaknesses: Mental manipulation via Jenova cells if exposed to specific lifestream frequencies
limitations: Physical body can be incapacitated, requiring his spirit or Jenova cells to reform

sources.supports: Sephiroth's abilities, magic, and feats across the Final Fantasy VII series.

feats.claim: Sliced an entire building and massive structures cleanly in half with a single sword stroke.

notableResults.note: Fought to a stalemate in the Edge of Creation.

campaignTags.claim: Mastery of high-level black magic and summoning spells.
Casts complex magical spells without an external focus.

unknowns: The true extent of his control over the Lifestream.

characters.summary: Bizarro Sephiroth is a monstrous, multi-limbed genetic mutation combining Sephiroth's upper torso with machinery and organic mass. He attacks with elemental beams and massive physical strikes from multiple appendages.

mechanisms: Multiple targetable body parts with separate health pools

weaknesses: Core can be exposed by destroying surrounding limbs and mechanical attachments
limitations: Immobile or restricted movement compared to his humanoid form
characters.formDifferences: Mutates Sephiroth's humanoid body into a multi-limbed bio-mechanical monstrosity with isolated defensive segments.

sources.supports: Bizarro Sephiroth stats, abilities, and form characteristics.

feats.claim: Engaged Cloud and party in a multi-stage battle across the Northern Crater.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Cloud and party before final transition.

conditional.dependsOn: Transformed state using Jenova and Lifestream energy

campaignTags.claim: Stands massively taller and wider than a normal human.

unknowns: Whether this form possesses higher intelligence or acts purely on instinct and Jenova programming.

characters.summary: Safer Sephiroth is the angelic, winged final combat form of Sephiroth. He wields apocalyptic magic, including the universe-shattering Supernova attack.

mechanisms: Invulnerability aura until specific conditions are met

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ultimate limit breaks after shields are bypassed
limitations: Requires tremendous energy buildup to execute top-tier spells
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Sephiroth into a seraphim-like entity with one massive black wing, halo, and planetary-scale spellcasting capability.

sources.supports: Safer Sephiroth form, Supernova spell, and battle mechanics.

feats.claim: Summoned a meteor/supernova that traversed the solar system, destroying planets before impacting the sun.

campaignTags.claim: Floats effortlessly with a single large black wing.
Casts reality-bending magic across solar systems.
Commands high-tier divine and destruction magic.

unknowns: The exact mechanics of how Supernova does not permanently kill the caster.

characters.summary: Shadow the Hedgehog is the Ultimate Life Form, possessing extreme super-speed, chaos energy manipulation, and mastery of firearms and vehicles.
weaknesses: Depletion of Chaos Emerald energy reserves if overusing Chaos Control
limitations: Requires limiters (inhibitor rings) to safely manage his extreme raw power

sources.supports: Shadow's background as Ultimate Life Form, Chaos powers, and abilities.

feats.claim: Broke the sound barrier on foot without the aid of vehicles.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill on Prison Island and the ARK.

campaignTags.claim: Hovers and flies using Chaos energy.
Teleports instantaneously via Chaos Control.

unknowns: Exact limits of his biological immortality.

characters.summary: Shadow empowered by Black Doom's biological lineage, granting enhanced demonic flight wings and dark energy projection.
weaknesses: Psychological vulnerability to Black Doom's hive mind influence
limitations: Dependent on Black Arms biological connection
characters.formDifferences: Grants Shadow large organic wings for sustained flight and bolsters dark energy output.

sources.supports: Black Arms heritage and related forms.

feats.claim: Soared through the atmosphere under his own wing power to fight Black Doom.

notableResults.note: Defeated Devil Doom after embracing his true potential.

conditional.ability: Flight via dark wings and enhanced dark energy

campaignTags.claim: Flies using membranous dark wings derived from Black Arms DNA.

unknowns: Long-term stability of Black Arms mutations without Chaos Emeralds.

characters.summary: Super Shadow is achieved by harnessing the power of all seven Chaos Emeralds, granting invulnerability, true flight, and god-like reality-bending power.

mechanisms: Complete invulnerability to physical and energy attacks

weaknesses: Extremely high ring consumption rate; form expires quickly without constant ring supply
limitations: Time-limited form constrained by ring energy
characters.formDifferences: Turns fur golden, grants golden aura, absolute invulnerability, and frictionless space flight.

sources.supports: Super Shadow transformation, powers, and emerald requirements.

feats.claim: Teleported the Space Colony ARK back into orbit alongside Super Sonic.

notableResults.note: Defeated Finalhazard in outer space with Super Sonic.

campaignTags.claim: Flies freely at hypersonic speeds in space and atmosphere.
Instantaneous teleportation across planetary distances.

unknowns: Maximum energy output limit when multiple emerald users are present.

characters.summary: Sly Cooper is a master thief specializing in stealth, acrobatics, and gadgetry. He dispatches guards silently using his hooked cane and agile rooftop navigation.
weaknesses: Standard human-level physical durability against heavy artillery or explosives
limitations: Relies heavily on stealth and agility rather than brute-force slugfests

sources.supports: Sly Cooper's abilities, thievery tools, and combat style.

feats.claim: Infiltrated heavily guarded maximum-security vaults without triggering alarms.

notableResults.citation: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus
notableResults.note: Defeated the immortal mechanical owl using turret combat and ancestral techniques.

campaignTags.claim: Glides using his thief hat/paraglider cape.
Utilizes alarm clocks, stealth smoke bombs, and burglar tech.
Specializes in invisible stealth assassinations and silent infiltration.

unknowns: Exact weight limit of objects he can pickpocket undetected.

characters.summary: Solid Snake is a legendary covert ops specialist and master of CQC (Close Quarters Combat). He utilizes advanced stealth gear, tactical weaponry, and environmental camouflage to eliminate targets.
weaknesses: Aged physiology in later operations causing physical strain
limitations: Flesh-and-blood human endurance limits despite peak conditioning

sources.supports: Solid Snake's military background, weapons, and infiltration feats.

feats.claim: Destroyed multiple walking nuclear-armed bipedal tanks (Metal Gears) single-handedly.

notableResults.note: Defeated Liquid in hand-to-hand combat and via FOXDIE virus.

campaignTags.claim: Master of infiltration using OctoCamo and camouflage.
Uses Solid Eye sonar, C4, chaff grenades, and suppressed weaponry.

unknowns: Full extent of FOXDIE pathogen progression timing prior to its activation.
